job.system:
You are the AI assistant for Meridian Ocean Minerals. Our staff use you for day-to-day work: research, writing, data, scheduling, and operations.

About us: Meridian Ocean Minerals is a deep-sea mining company headquartered in Houston, with a policy office in Washington, DC. Our mission is to commercially recover polymetallic nodules from the deep seabed, a vast source of nickel, cobalt, manganese, and copper, and to supply these critical minerals for batteries, the energy transition, and economic growth. We believe the United States must lead in this industry. Our policy team works with lawmakers to protect our ability to continue exploration and commercial development.

Current focus: Our top priority this fall is S. 2817, the Deep Seabed Mining Prohibition Act, which would shut down our core work and which we strongly oppose. The Senate Commerce Committee will mark up the bill on Thursday, October 15.

You run in our internal chat app, which has no tools, browsing, or code execution, so work everything out directly in your reply. Staff rely on your work, so be accurate and thorough.

House side: Cannon ↔ Longworth 5 min, Longworth ↔ Rayburn 5 min, Cannon ↔ Rayburn 10 min. Any Senate building ↔ any House building: 25 min. Same building: no travel time. ## Checks

- **Office windows:** Every meeting fits entirely inside its office's window.
- **Walking time:** Every transition allows enough time. The tightest ones are Montoya → Rourke (not used), Gallagher → Montoya (25 min, 25 needed), Okafor → Vasquez (15 min, 10 needed), and Crowe → Brooks (30 min, 20 needed).
- **Team availability:** Team B starts at 11:00 Tuesday and finishes at 14:15 Wednesday, before its 15:00 cutoff.
- **Lunch:** Every team gets at least 30 minutes between 11:30 and 14:00 each day. The walk to the next meeting fits after the break, so this holds even under a strict reading of the lunch rule.

## Why this is the best I found

- **Doyle, Fischer and Okafor can't all happen Wednesday.** All three fall around 13:00–14:15, and neither 13:00 meeting ends early enough to walk to Russell for Doyle at 13:45. So Okafor (or Fischer) has to move to Tuesday morning.
- **Rourke has to be Tuesday morning,** when only Team A is in town. Rourke at 9:30 followed by Okafor at 10:15 is the pairing that keeps all 8 Tier 1s. The other options either drop a Tier 1 (best case I found was 74 points) or score 1 point less (Fischer instead of Okafor gives 78).
- **Wednesday afternoon fits at most three of Abernathy, Crowe, Brooks and Pruitt.** Brooks and Pruitt both fall in Team A's late slot, so Pruitt doesn't fit.
- **Nakamura (Tue 10:45, Rayburn)** can only be reached by giving up Okafor or Fischer, which costs more than it gains.

I worked this out by hand rather than with a solver. I checked the main alternatives, and several swaps tie at 79 (for example, Alvarez on Tuesday and Grant on Wednesday), but I couldn't find anything higher.
